## What this is -- and is not

- Sends a real WhatsApp template message **only when connected to live credentials and a real Graph API URL**. Repository testing uses a local mock server, never the real Meta API.
- Requires a WhatsApp Business account, phone-number ID, access token, and an **already-approved** message template -- none of that is provided here.
- **No automatic retries** -- intentional, to avoid sending duplicate WhatsApp messages on transient failures.
- **No delivery-status tracking.** This only reports whether the send request was accepted, not whether the message was actually delivered/read.
- Never put a live access token directly in a node parameter -- always use the Header Auth credential, created manually after import.
